concept: Allocation path behind MTLResourceStorageModeShared buffers (IOGPU vs IOSurface)
summary: The macOS `footprint` tool lists MLX Metal allocations under a region named "IOAccelerator (graphics)", so the allocation is accounted as graphics (IOAccelerator) memory, not as a plain malloc or IOSurface region.

facts.text: The macOS `footprint` tool lists MLX Metal allocations under a region named "IOAccelerator (graphics)", so the allocation is accounted as graphics (IOAccelerator) memory, not as a plain malloc or IOSurface region.
The same tool output marked those pages "all DIRTY, 0 reclaimable".
Whether an IOSurface sits underneath is not stated in any source read.
`footprint <pid>` on an M5 Max running MLX 0.32.0 showed 109 GB under "IOAccelerator (graphics)", all dirty, with phys_footprint 110 GB.
The existing dossier's allocation-path open question is narrowed to the IOAccelerator (graphics) family; IOSurface is not named in this footprint listing.
